+"""Load image references through storage or a validated public HTTP connection."""
+
+import base64
+import binascii
+import ipaddress
+import socket
+from urllib.parse import quote, unquote, urljoin, urlsplit
+
+import urllib3
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+_PUBLIC_IPV6 = ipaddress.ip_network("2000::/3")
+
+
+def _public_address(hostname: str, port: int) -> str:
+    addresses = [
+        ipaddress.ip_address(result[4][0])
+        for result in socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, port, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    ]
+    for address in addresses:
+        if not address.is_global or address.is_multicast or address.is_reserved:
+            raise ValueError("Image host resolves to a non-public address")
+        if isinstance(address, ipaddress.IPv6Address) and (
+            address not in _PUBLIC_IPV6 or address.sixtofour or address.teredo or address.scope_id
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Image host resolves to an unsupported IPv6 address")
+    if not addresses:
+        raise ValueError("Image host has no addresses")
+    return str(addresses[0])
+
+
+def _read_storage_key(key: str) -> bytes | None:
+    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    if "\\" in key or any(ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in key):
+        return None
+    return storage.download_image(key)
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(reference: str | None, *, timeout: float = 30) -> bytes | None:
+    if not reference:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        if reference.startswith("data:image/"):
+            metadata, encoded = reference.split(",", 1)
+            if metadata.endswith(";base64"):
+                return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+            return None
+
+        storage_url = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST or "")
+        storage_prefix = storage_url.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+        for _ in range(6):
+            if "\\" in reference or any(ord(char) <= 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in reference):
+                return None
+            url = urlsplit(reference)
+            if not url.scheme and not url.netloc and not reference.startswith("/"):
+                return _read_storage_key(reference)
+            if url.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not url.hostname or "@" in url.netloc:
+                return None
+
+            if (
+                url.scheme == storage_url.scheme
+                and url.netloc.lower() == storage_url.netloc.lower()
+                and url.path.startswith(storage_prefix)
+            ):
+                return _read_storage_key(unquote(url.path[len(storage_prefix):]))
+
+            hostname = url.hostname.encode("idna").decode("ascii")
+            port = url.port or (443 if url.scheme == "https" else 80)
+            address = _public_address(hostname, port)
+            # Connect to the checked IP. Keep the original hostname for HTTP and TLS.
+            options = {"port": port, "timeout": timeout}
+            if url.scheme == "https":
+                pool = urllib3.HTTPSConnectionPool(
+                    address, **options, server_hostname=hostname, assert_hostname=hostname
+                )
+            else:
+                pool = urllib3.HTTPConnectionPool(address, **options)
+
+            authority = f"[{hostname}]" if ":" in hostname else hostname
+            if url.port is not None:
+                authority = f"{authority}:{port}"
+            target = quote(url.path or "/", safe="/%:@!$&'()*+,;=")
+            if url.query:
+                target += "?" + quote(url.query, safe="/?%:@!$&'()*+,;=")
+            with pool:
+                response = pool.urlopen(
+                    "GET", target, headers={"Host": authority}, redirect=False, retries=False
+                )
+                if response.status == 200:
+                    return response.data
+                location = response.get_redirect_location()
+                if not location:
+                    return None
+                reference = urljoin(reference, location)
+    except (ValueError, binascii.Error, OSError, urllib3.exceptions.HTTPError):
+        logger.warning("Unable to load image reference")
+    return None

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("redirect", [None, "https://internal.example/panel.png"])
+def test_https_uses_validated_ip_and_checks_redirects(monkeypatch, image_bytes, redirect):
+    resolver = Mock(side_effect=[dns_records("93.184.215.14"), dns_records("10.0.0.1")])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(image_loader.socket, "getaddrinfo", resolver)
+    response = Mock(status=302 if redirect else 200, data=image_bytes)
+    response.get_redirect_location.return_value = redirect
+    pool = Mock()
+    pool.__enter__ = Mock(return_value=pool)
+    pool.__exit__ = Mock(return_value=False)
+    pool.urlopen.return_value = response
+    connect = Mock(return_value=pool)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(image_loader.urllib3, "HTTPSConnectionPool", connect)
+
+    result = image_loader.load_image_bytes("https://image.example/panel.png?size=2")
+    assert result == (None if redirect else image_bytes)
+    connect.assert_called_once_with(
+        "93.184.215.14", port=443, timeout=30,
+        server_hostname="image.example", assert_hostname="image.example",
+    )
+    pool.urlopen.assert_called_once_with(
+        "GET", "/panel.png?size=2", headers={"Host": "image.example"},
+        redirect=False, retries=False,
+    )
+    assert resolver.call_count == (2 if redirect else 1)
+

+def test_storage_and_data_images_require_no_url_resolution(monkeypatch, image_bytes):

+    for reference in (key, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}", data_url(image_bytes)):
+        assert BaseAIService()._download_image(reference) == image_bytes
+        assert download_image(reference).size == (2, 3)
+    resolver.assert_not_called()

+def test_export_skips_blocked_images_in_zip_and_strip(client, monkeypatch, image_bytes):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(image_loader.socket, "getaddrinfo", Mock(return_value=dns_records("10.0.0.1")))
+    connect = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(image_loader.urllib3, "HTTPConnectionPool", connect)
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert project.status_code == 200, project.text
+    episode = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=headers, json={
+        "title": "Pilot", "project_id": project.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1,
+    })
+    assert episode.status_code == 200, episode.text
+    episode_id = episode.json()["id"]
+    key = storage.upload_image(image_bytes, "panels", episode_id)
+    for order, reference in enumerate(("http://internal.example/image.png", key, data_url(image_bytes)), 1):
+        cut = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": order, "image_path": reference,
+        })
+        assert cut.status_code == 200, cut.text
+
+    zip_response = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=headers)
+    assert zip_response.status_code == 200, zip_response.text
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_response.content)) as archive:
+        assert archive.namelist() == ["Pilot_02.png", "Pilot_03.png", "missing.txt"]
+        assert archive.read("Pilot_02.png") == image_bytes
+        assert archive.read("Pilot_03.png") == image_bytes
+        assert archive.read("missing.txt") == b"1\n"
+
+    strip = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export", headers=headers)
+    assert strip.status_code == 200, strip.text
+    assert Image.open(io.BytesIO(strip.content)).size == (2, 56)
+    connect.assert_not_called()
+
+    outsider = signup(client, email="outsider@example.com")
+    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=outsider)
+    assert response.status_code == 403
